title: The Rabby Swap

captures.note: dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Rabby's built-in Swap, ETH→USDC (Rabby pre-fills USDC as the target). Rabby's server asks the aggregators and returns the winning quote with the calldata you sign: 1inch won, through 1inch's router 0x1111…2a65, with a 0.25% Rabby fee and 1% slippage. The browser never contacted 1inch; Rabby did. MEV Protection is on by default; the tx went out through Rabby's own submit_tx like R1. After signing, Rabby is also sent the trade record — POST api.rabby.io/v1/wallet/swap_trade carries the quote (pay/receive token and amounts, dex 1inch, fee rate) plus the full tx with your from-address — and DeBank's festats gets swapRequestQuote / swapQuoteResult events. Real mainnet tx 0x735ee6e15c34d9ab78df6866ef0eaf7e00c153930f69b01823bdab657a429b0c.

prepend_steps.name: Rabby · slippage advice
prepend_steps.purpose: Server suggests and checks the slippage tolerance for this pair
prepend_steps.returns: the slippage the quote is built with (1%)

worst_lie.note: a loose tolerance lets the trade fill far below the quoted price

prepend_steps.name: Rabby swap engine · quote + calldata
prepend_steps.purpose: Rabby's server queries DEX aggregators and returns the winner (1inch) with minimum-out and the router calldata the wallet signs
prepend_steps.returns: the price you accept and the exact bytes you sign

worst_lie.note: a bad route or minimum-out drains value within slippage; the wallet can't price-check it locally

prepend_steps.notes: The aggregator never sees you directly: Rabby fetches quotes server-side. Rabby's fee 0.25% is shown on the swap screen.

prepend_steps.name: DeBank festats · quote events
prepend_steps.purpose: Analytics pings for each quote request and result
prepend_steps.notes: Query strings are not logged, so the fields these GETs carry are not read.

prepend_steps.name: Rabby · router contract check
prepend_steps.purpose: Looks up the router contract and whether you've used it before, for the sign screen's risk labels
prepend_steps.returns: 'known contract / first interaction' labels on the sign bar

worst_lie.note: a malicious router labelled as known
